review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. For the Honduran reviewer: "¿En qué trabajás?" (vos); "Soy médico" / "Sos enfermera" (no article before a profession); "ellos trabajan"; "todos los días"; "Mi trabajo es..." (the noun); Sam says "estudio español".

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.english: It has big rooms and beds.

sentences.text: Ana sale de la casa a las seis.
sentences.english: Ana leaves the house at six.

sentences.text: Llega al hospital a las siete.
sentences.english: She gets to the hospital at seven.

sentences.speaker: ana
sentences.text: Mi trabajo es ayudar a los médicos.
sentences.english: My job is to help the doctors.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: What do you do every day?

sentences.speaker: ana
sentences.text: Los lunes también llego a las siete.
sentences.english: On Mondays I also arrive at seven.

sentences.text: Trabaja con Ana en la clínica.
sentences.english: He works with Ana at the clinic.

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.text: Sí, estoy con Ana en la clínica.
sentences.english: Yes, I am with Ana at the clinic.

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.text: Yo soy maestro en la escuela.
sentences.english: I am a teacher at the school.

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.text: Mi trabajo es todos los días.

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.english: Ana and I work a lot.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Ellos tienen hambre en la tarde.
sentences.english: They are hungry in the afternoon.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Ellos comen mi sopa con arroz y frijoles.
sentences.english: They eat my soup with rice and beans.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Un plato de sopa cuesta diez lempiras.
sentences.english: A plate of soup costs ten lempiras.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: Yo vendo comida en el mercado.
sentences.english: I sell food at the market.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: I sell tamales, soup and baleadas.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: A las seis hago el desayuno.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: La señora Elena dice que son baratos.
sentences.english: Señora Elena says they are cheap.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: I need plantains for the soup.

sentences.speaker: ana
sentences.english: And you, Sam, what do you do?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Mi maestro dice que hablo bien.
sentences.english: My teacher says I speak well.

sentences.speaker: ana
sentences.text: Sam y Nico están en la casa.
sentences.english: Sam and Nico are at home.

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.english: Daniel, what are you doing today?

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.text: Hoy voy a la clínica con Ana.
sentences.english: Today I am going to the clinic with Ana.

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.english: I am going to the school.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Y yo voy al mercado con doña Marta.
sentences.english: And I am going to the market with doña Marta.

sentences.text: Karla trabaja en la escuela con Luis.
sentences.english: Karla works at the school with Luis.

sentences.text: El señor Mario trabaja en la iglesia.
sentences.english: Mr. Mario works at the church.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Karla, what do you do at the school?

sentences.speaker: karla
sentences.text: El señor Mario sale de la casa a las ocho.
sentences.english: Mr. Mario leaves the house at eight.

sentences.speaker: karla
sentences.text: Llega a la iglesia a las nueve.
sentences.english: He gets to the church at nine.

sentences.speaker: karla
sentences.text: Mi mamá vende pan en el mercado.
sentences.english: My mom sells bread at the market.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Los lunes voy al mercado con Nico.
sentences.english: On Mondays I go to the market with Nico.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: Yes, there is rice and chicken.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: Today there is coffee for everyone.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: Y yo voy a la escuela con Luis.
sentences.english: And I go to school with Luis.

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.text: Sí, y Nico habla mucho en la casa.
sentences.english: Yes, and Nico talks a lot at home.
